description: This file defines a Java interface named Subjects that represents a collection of Subject objects within a policy management context. It includes static methods for creating new instances, methods for retrieving, setting, removing subjects, and querying their size and contents, with functionalities related to JSON serialization and schema version support.

classes.name: Subjects
classes.description: A collection interface for handling multiple Subject objects within a policy, providing methods for creation, retrieval, modification, removal, and serialization of subjects.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Subjects collection from an iterable of Subject objects or individual Subject instances.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the array of JSON schema versions supported by Subjects, specifically V_2.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Retrieves a Subject based on issuer+ID or issuer+subject, returning an Optional.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Adds or replaces a Subject in the collection, returning a new copy.

methods.name: removeSubject
methods.description: Removes a Subject identified by issuer+ID, issuer+subject, or SubjectId, returning a new collection.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of Subjects in the collection.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the collection contains no Subjects.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a sequential Stream of the Subjects.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Subjects collection to a JsonObject, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes the Subjects collection to a JsonObject based on provided schema version and field selector.
